title: SENIOR PRODUCT SPECIALIST
description:

**Major accountabilities:**

* Drive Competitive Sales Growth
* Personalize and orchestrate customer engagement journeys for target HCPs by reflecting customer preferences, leveraging available content and multiple engagement channels
* Build engagement by working in partnership with HCPs to develop a sustained collaboration over time for Novartis
* Deliver memorable, customer-centric experiences beyond clinical differentiation by listening to their needs and understanding their healthcare environment
* Leverage available data sources to create, dynamically prioritize and adjust relevant territory, account and customer interaction plans
* Share customer insights with relevant internal stakeholders on an ongoing basis to support the development of product-and indication-related content, campaigns and interaction plans
* Deliver Value to Customers and Patients
* Collaborate compliantly with cross-functional teams to design and implement solutions that address unmet customer and patient needs

* When facing ethical dilemmas, do the right thing and speak up when things don't seem right.

* Reporting of technical complaints / adverse events / special case scenarios related to Novartis products within 24 hours of receipt.

title: Pre-Sales Solution Consultant
description:
**Overview**
**About Certara**
Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.
  
  
Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.
  
  
Certara is hiring a Pre-Sales Solution Consultant based in India focusing on driving growth for Certara’s existing and future solutions, supporting the Enterprise Account Managers provide valuable solutions to our Enterprise Life Sciences customers. In this role, he or she will build and maintain a thorough understanding of Certara products and services and work closely with the team locally and globally to manage and grow our existing business through our direct sales model, but also leveraging other Certara strategic partners as needed in the process. The successful candidate will be involved in early discussions with our prospective customers to understand their business objectives and design a technical solution that would meet and exceed their expectations both as a business solution, short and long term, as well as adopting the technical infrastructure required for such implementation.
  
  

* This is a highly customer facing position and requires a unique mix of scientific, technical, business process, presentation, and communication skills in the technical sales process.
* Travel to customer and partner sites is required.
* This position is based in India.
* Scientific industry knowledge including competitive landscape, solution linkage, understanding and uncovering key requirements, in order to properly position our software and service solutions within the assigned accounts is required.
* This role requires strong initiative, self-motivation and collaborative skills to work with other team members within and externally to Certara.
* The ideal candidate for this position will possess a strong complex technical sales aptitude and a willingness to grow our business utilizing complex sales methodologies and approaches.

The candidate must be keenly aware of organizational growth initiatives related to the life science market and target customer segments, as well as Certara’s potential to meet customer needs with our software products and services. Ultimately, the Solution Consultant is also responsible for bookings and revenue growth through the use of value creation for our customers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**
**include and is not limited to :**

* Actively supports the sales team and business partners as an expert on the technical, functional and integration of Certara Enterprise Solutions and Services.
* Technical Subject matter expert and lead for responses to Requests For Information (RFIs) and Requests For Proposal (RFPs).
* Understand and influence customer’s short term and long-term initiatives that align with Certara software and services solutions.
* Support Marketing Activities as needed as the Technical Subject Matter Expert on Certara Solution and Services.
* Serves as a point-of-contact for technical and functional questions and drives the resolutions of said concerns by the clients and or partners.
* Develops and maintains relationships with clients, partners and internal groups with the common goal of increasing market share for Certara enterprise solutions and services.
* Participate in professional trade shows and clinical conferences, or the equivalent, (or as practically possible), supporting client meetings and or solution demonstrations.
* Deliver presentations and product seminar tours at scientific conferences as required.
* Develop sales material, presentations, software demonstrations and evaluation materials.
* Deliver product training to marketing & sales on new functionalities for designated products to clarify the features and the benefits to our customers.
* Utilize market knowledge and industry contacts to grow the Certara business in line with agreed commercial goals.
* Meet and exceed sales quota on a quarterly, and annual basis.
* Follow Certara processes and best practices for properly working Marketing Qualified Leads ( MQL’s ).

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years as a Solution Specialist, within the pharmaceutical and enterprise B2B SaaS and or Services industries.
* Bachelor’s degree or above (in a science discipline) or advanced business degree preferred.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written in English.
* Exceptional presentation skills, both in customer meetings, face to face and or on-line, as well as at trade shows and or large audiences.
* Attention to detail and uncovering hidden customer requirements.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multi-task and set priorities.
* Ability to work in a high energy team environment.
* Able to fully utilize the MS Office suite (Excel/Word/PPT)

**Values:**

* High degree of professionalism: Lives the values of transparency, authenticity, collaboration, respect and accountability
* Is a “Continuous Learner”
* Team Player who will always find a path to success

*Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Business Development Manager
description: Company Description Meta Lung Klinics is a specialized healthcare organization focused on providing comprehensive lung and respiratory care services. The clinic is committed to delivering patient-centered care supported by modern diagnostics, evidence-based treatments, and multidisciplinary clinical expertise. Meta Lung Klinics emphasizes quality, safety, and accessibility, aiming to improve health outcomes for individuals with pulmonary conditions. The organization encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation, offering team members an environment where they can contribute meaningfully to community health and grow in their careers.Role Description The Business Development Manager at Meta Lung Klinics will be responsible for driving growth by identifying new business opportunities, building strategic partnerships, and expanding the clinic’s presence in the Kondapur area. This full-time, on-site role includes managing referral networks, engaging with physicians, hospitals, and corporate clients, and developing outreach programs to increase patient volume and service utilization. The role involves conducting market research, analyzing competitive trends, and recommending initiatives to enhance brand visibility and service offerings. The Business Development Manager will collaborate with clinical and administrative teams to design and implement marketing campaigns, track performance metrics, and ensure a high-quality experience for patients and partners. The position also includes preparing business proposals, managing key accounts, and reporting progress to leadership on a regular basis.Qualifications Demonstrated experience in business development, sales, or healthcare marketing, preferably in clinics, hospitals, or diagnostic centers.Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with medical professionals, corporate clients, and community partners.Proficiency in market research, data analysis, and reporting to support decision-making and growth strategies.Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to convey value propositions clearly and persuasively.Solid organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and meet targets in a fast-paced environment.Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Management, or a related field; an advanced degree or relevant certifications are an advantage.Comfort working on-site in Kondapur, with a willingness to conduct field visits, attend events, and represent the clinic in external forums.Knowledge of local healthcare markets and referral ecosystems is highly beneficial; prior experience in lung care or specialty clinics is a plus.

title: Retail Sales Lead- First Colony Mall
description:
Founded in 2010, POP MART is a leading global pop culture and entertainment company. With IP at its core, POP MART works with artists and designers worldwide to develop and operate IPs, creating products, services and entertainment experiences for consumers. Its portfolio includes beloved IP characters such as THE MONSTERS , TWINKLE TWINKLE, CRYBABY, DIMOO, SKULLPANDA, Hirono and MOLLY. As of the first half of 2026, POP MART had more than 100 million registered members worldwide, operated 676 physical stores and over 2,800 ROBO SHOP vending machines, and reached nearly 100 countries and regions through cross-border e-commerce platforms,bringing joy to consumers around the world.
  
  
**Opportunity Overview:**
At POP MART, we believe art has the power to inspire joy, spark imagination, and bring people together. As a Sales Lead, you'll play a key leadership role in creating exceptional customer experiences while supporting the daily operations of the store. As a trusted leader on the sales floor, you'll inspire your team, ensure operational excellence, and help bring the POP MART brand to life for every customer.
  
  
You'll serve as the Leader on Duty when the Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager is unavailable, providing direction to the team, driving sales performance, and ensuring our stores consistently deliver the premium experience our collectors expect. From coaching associates and supporting visual merchandising to inventory management and new product launches, you'll help create an engaging environment where customers can discover the excitement of POP MART.
  
  
This position reports directly to the Store Manager.
  
  
**What you will achieve:**
**Leadership & Customer Experience**

* Lead by example to deliver an exceptional customer experience and inspire a customer-first culture.
* Serve as the Leader on Duty in the absence of the Store Manager or Assistant Store Manager, ensuring smooth daily operations.
* Coach, motivate, and support Sales Associates to achieve individual and store performance goals.

* Foster an energetic, inclusive, and engaging environment for customers and team members alike.

**Sales & Business Performance**

* Help achieve and exceed store sales goals and key performance indicators (KPIs), including sales, conversion, units per transaction (UPT), average transaction value (ATV), and customer engagement.
* Promote key product categories, limited-edition releases, and exclusive collections through knowledgeable product recommendations.
* Identify opportunities to improve store performance and communicate operational needs or business opportunities to store leadership.

**Store Operations**

* Execute opening and closing procedures while ensuring operational excellence and compliance with company policies.
* Maintain a clean, organized, safe, and visually compelling store environment.
* Accurately process customer transactions, returns, exchanges, and other POS activities.
* Support shipment processing, replenishment, stockroom organization, inventory accuracy, and cycle counts.
* Help protect company assets by following cash handling, safety, and loss prevention procedures.

**Visual Merchandising & Inventory**
*(Responsibilities may vary based on store volume and business needs.)*

* Execute POP MART visual merchandising standards, marketing directives, and promotional displays.
* Install new fixtures, marketing materials, decals, and planograms for product launches and seasonal campaigns.
* Refresh merchandising based on inventory levels, product sell-through, and business priorities.
* Support inventory audits, receiving, transfers, replenishment, and back-of-house organization.
* Partner with store leadership to maintain inventory accuracy and ensure merchandise is available for customers.

**Brand & Community**

* Serve as a knowledgeable brand ambassador by staying current on POP MART products, artists, characters, and company initiatives.
* Support in-store events, collector experiences, pop-up activations, conventions, new store openings, and other brand initiatives.
* Support Robo Shop operations and partner with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience where applicable.
* Maintain flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and other peak business periods.

**What you will need:**

* 1+ years of retail experience; previous leadership, keyholder, or supervisory experience preferred.
* Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and leading by example.
* Interest in designer toys, collectibles, art, anime, gaming, fashion, or pop culture is highly valued.
* Strong communication, coaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to motivate others while fostering a collaborative, inclusive team environment.
* Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Comfortable making decisions and prioritizing tasks in a fast-paced retail environment.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret business metrics and use data to improve store performance.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs.

title: Sales Staff

**Company Description** 
 Greentek India Limited is an integrated solar engineering company with roots in the solar sector since 1997 and incorporation in 2007\. The organization designs, manufactures, executes, monitors, and maintains solar solutions ranging from residential rooftops to institutional hot\-water plants and utility\-scale projects. Its EPC business spans residential rooftop projects under PM Surya Ghar, commercial and industrial plants under CAPEX, OPEX and PPA models, operations and maintenance services, and Adani Solar module supply as an authorized channel partner. Greentek operates a BIS\-licensed manufacturing unit in Shabaspalle, Medak, producing solar flat plate collectors, absorber fins and storage tanks, and is ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certified and MNRE approved.
